description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce—1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The work focuses on the complexity of the Dutch struggle for independence from Spanish rule, particularly examining the military and political maneuvers during the era.
